"""Core cue timing utilities shared by the subtitle export pipeline."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List


DEFAULT_MIN_GAP_MS = 40


@dataclass
class Cue:
    index: int
    start_ms: int
    end_ms: int
    text: str

    @property
    def duration_ms(self) -> int:
        return self.end_ms - self.start_ms


def group_overlap_clusters(cues: List[Cue], min_gap_ms: int = DEFAULT_MIN_GAP_MS) -> List[List[Cue]]:
    """Partition sorted cues into runs that touch or overlap each other.

    ``cues`` must already be sorted by start_ms. A new cluster starts
    whenever a cue begins at least ``min_gap_ms`` after the latest end
    time seen so far in the current cluster, i.e. there is a genuine
    break in the dialogue.
    """
    if not cues:
        return []

    clusters: List[List[Cue]] = []
    cluster_start = 0
    cluster_end = cues[0].end_ms
    for i in range(1, len(cues)):
        if cues[i].start_ms >= cluster_end + min_gap_ms:
            clusters.append(cues[cluster_start:i])
            cluster_start = i
            cluster_end = cues[i].end_ms
        else:
            cluster_end = max(cluster_end, cues[i].end_ms)

    clusters.append(cues[cluster_start:len(cues)])
    return clusters


def merge_cluster(cluster: List[Cue]) -> Cue:
    """Collapse a cluster of overlapping cues into a single displayed cue.

    The merged cue spans the earliest start and the latest end found
    anywhere in the cluster, since a cue in the middle of the group can
    easily outlast the one that opened it. Each source line is stacked
    underneath the previous one so viewers can still tell the
    overlapping captions apart.
    """
    start_ms = min(c.start_ms for c in cluster)
    end_ms = max(c.end_ms for c in cluster)
    lines = [c.text for c in cluster[:len(cluster) - 1]]
    return Cue(cluster[0].index, start_ms, end_ms, "\n".join(lines))
